function.arguments: {"research_topic":"Investigate the HyperFund/HyperVerse alleged cryptocurrency-fraud network as of October 1, 2026, using only reliable benchmark-tool-returned evidence and preserving every source ID exactly. Produce a structured evidence dossier addressing: (1) the operating model, including alleged Ponzi-style mechanics, recruitment dependence, promised returns, incentives, withdrawal or payment behavior, and referral or multilevel structures; (2) investor-facing claims and language; (3) promotional channels, public promoters, celebrities, influencers, or other public figures and what they actually said or did; (4) the chronology of organizational names and branding changes from HyperFund to HyperVerse and any further names, including documented reasons or alleged purposes, distinguishing fact from interpretation; (5) the identity, biography, credentials, titles, and public presentation of the person described as the purported or alleged chief executive, including any conflicting accounts; (6) corroboration, inconsistencies, disputed facts, unsupported points, and uncertainty. For every factual proposition, provide source IDs returned by the benchmark tools, quote or closely summarize the evidence, identify the entity and relationship only if directly supported, and label whether it is verified, alleged, analytical, or unresolved. Do not fill gaps with general knowledge, and do not invent source IDs."}
function.name: ConductResearch
